learnings.title: GitHub changelog: Copilot code review billing defaults to the organization from 2026-12-30
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-25-copilot-code-review-billing-will-default-to-the-organization (feed pubDate Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:18:03 +0000; read 2026-11-27) states that if no billing choice is saved for Copilot code review of members with a Copilot license, those reviews will be billed to the organization starting December 30, 2026; selecting Member before then keeps current billing. Applies to organizations and enterprises with Copilot Business or Enterprise. Existing Member or Organization choices stay. Accounts without AI Credits paid usage, with a billing lock, or with no billable customer are set to Member instead. The separate setting for members without a Copilot license does not change. Organization billing requires AI Credits paid usage and can increase spending.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: if the system plan has Copilot Business/Enterprise org settings, review and explicitly choose Member or Organization before 2026-12-30; no automated policy change.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-12-15 whether any owned org uses Copilot Business/Enterprise code review billing and what was selected.
